site.name: Reikai
site.tagline: Curated open-source tools for privacy, hardening and debloating.
site.description: A free, open-source hub of browser hardening and privacy tools. Built by the community, for the community.

projects.name: firefox-debloat
projects.description: Stacks firefox-debloat + Arkenfox + Betterfox + your overrides on the official Mozilla Firefox binary. Telemetry, ads, AI and fingerprinting off. uBlock Origin, Proton Pass, Privacy Badger, TWP, PopUpOFF, Popup Blocker and CanvasBlocker auto-installed. Brave Search by default. One-command revert. Works on Firefox, Zen Browser, Windows and Linux.

projects.name: reikai-enhance
projects.description: A companion enhancement toolkit. Planned: extra tweaks, themes and integrations that build on top of firefox-debloat. Not available yet.
